notes.title: 20230827_Ver.0.2.1 Update
notes.notes:
Thenks for playing “RIDLE”. 
The Ver.0.2.1 update has now been implemented. 

[b]Additions[/b]
・ Adding a navigation Window 
	Added an navigation window at the top of the screen for clearing the stage. 
・ Addition of shaking direction 
	Added a shaking effect to the entire screen when taking damage or sticking to a wall 

[b]Changes [/b]
・ Changed the RIDLE move process. 
	RIDLE can continue to move in the direction they are facing after sticking to a wall by inputting the move key. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41580950/f1ae54270483db694b1c3fa5242f516ca5e1552b.gif[/img]
・ Changed the direction when the Enemy is defeated. 
・The content of the explanatory video displayed in WILDERNESS STAGE Area1 has been changed. 
・Some changes have been made to the following stage configurations. 
	BRICKS STAGE Area1 
・ Change of BGM 
	Changed the BGM when clearing a stage. 
・ The content of the video that plays on the title screen has been changed. 

We look forward to your continued support of “RIDLE”.

notes.title: 20230827_Ver.0.1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Thanks for playing "RIDLE".
The Ver. 0.1.1 update has now been implemented.

[b]Changes[/b]
・Increased the number of instructional videos displayed in WILDERNESS STAGE Area 1.
・Some changes have been made to the following stage configurations.
　MECHANICAL STAGE Area2
　FOREST STAGE Area1
・Graphics of some gimmicks were changed.

[b]Bug Fix[/b]
・Fixed a freeze during boss battles and malfunctions of boss enemies.
・The animation when RIDLE's strength is recovered has been corrected.

We look forward to your continued support of "RIDLE".
